bootstrap_method: Whole-seed multinomial multiplicities, common across all condition arms; pooled rates are ratios of summed counts/exposure.

calibration.scope: Candidate-p selection uncertainty published separately; no policy results enter calibration.

selection.scope: Baseline-only candidate selection, not verified baseline matching.

control_window_diagnostic.interpretation: Finite-window diagnostic; nonsignificance does not establish stationarity.

stationary_bridge_prediction.scope: Fixed stationary q2 benchmark; full ICU bridges and policy transients need not satisfy its assumptions.
